composite_order: fixed_gantry (bottom) < movable_bell < movable_indicator (top). Reconstruction verified: composite matches the accepted reference except for 3866 intentionally keyed background-gap pixels and 56 rounding-noise pixels.

fixed_gantry.contents: Timber gantry complete: vertical mast, top crossbar arm, diagonal brace, rope bindings/lashings, suspension rope (both strands, in front of bell ring), indicator mounting pin + bolt + support timber + lashings, stone base. Complete behind removed bell/indicator; no occlusion repair was needed (rope and pin were fully visible in front of removed parts).

movable_bell.contents: Bell body + attached clapper + suspension ring (visible dark-metal parts only; ring top arc occluded by fixed rope strands is omitted, it stays hidden behind the rope in composite).

movable_indicator.contents: Side directional indicator: wooden arrow shaft + tail + circular hub disc. Hub has a pin-shaped cutout where the fixed mounting pin overlaps it (pin stays in fixed_gantry, in front).

notes: No HUD/dial text, no boss face, no new ornament added.
No blind cutout rotations; layers are pixel-exact cutouts from the accepted reference in the shared plane.
Runtime cell size 512x768 is delivery metadata only; masters are 746x1146.

attached_parts: clapper (inside bell mouth, moves with body)
bell_swing.description: Bell swing attachment/pivot: top-center of the bell's suspension ring at the rope contact point, measured from the accepted reference (ring outer ellipse center ~(157,239); rope strands grip the ring top around y 225-230). Rotate the movable_bell layer around this point for swing animation; the fixed rope strands stay in place in front of the ring.

indicator.description: Indicator rotation pivot: center of the real circular hub disc, measured by algebraic circle fit to the hub's outer rim (fit center ~(502,356), radius ~45px). Rotate the movable_indicator layer around this point; the hub disc is rotation-invariant, the arrow shaft+tail swing around it. The fixed mounting pin (x 522-558) stays in place in front of the hub's right side.

shared_plane.note: All three layers use the identical 746x1146 parent coordinate plane (same as the accepted reference). No independent bbox fit, no stretching, no per-layer rescaling.
